response.sql: WITH patient_avgs AS (SELECT p.ID, p.SEX, AVG(l.ALB) as avg_alb, AVG(l.TP) as avg_tp, AVG(l.APPT - l.PT) as avg_appt_minus_pt FROM Patient p INNER JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID GROUP BY p.ID, p.SEX), patient_diffs AS (SELECT ID, SEX, (avg_alb - avg_tp) as alb_minus_tp, avg_appt_minus_pt FROM patient_avgs), sex_avgs AS (SELECT SEX, AVG(alb_minus_tp) as sex_avg_alb_minus_tp, AVG(avg_appt_minus_pt) as sex_avg_appt_minus_pt FROM patient_diffs GROUP BY SEX), sex_mean AS (SELECT AVG(sex_avg_appt_minus_pt) as overall_mean_appt_minus_pt FROM sex_avgs), filtered_sexes AS (SELECT s.SEX, s.sex_avg_alb_minus_tp, s.sex_avg_appt_minus_pt, (s.sex_avg_appt_minus_pt - m.overall_mean_appt_minus_pt) as excess FROM sex_avgs s CROSS JOIN sex_mean m WHERE s.sex_avg_appt_minus_pt > m.overall_mean_appt_minus_pt) SELECT AVG(sex_avg_alb_minus_tp) as avg_alb_minus_tp, AVG(sex_avg_appt_minus_pt) as avg_appt_minus_pt, AVG(excess) as excess_over_mean FROM filtered_sexes
